title: 東京大賞典の後に・地方の“テッペン”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One wins the Tokyo Daishoten, securing her place at the top of the regional races. The crowd roars with cheers of her name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She turns to the audience and swears to conquer the top of the centrals too and become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the stands, Oguri Cap and Super Creek accept these words as a personal challenge, their spirits set ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide our first senior year race will be the spring Tenno Sho. It's time to take our fight to the central G1s!
